scope: Read-only review of new held-resolution baseline/review gate, prior recovery frozen mode, gzip baseline fallback and related regression tests. No code, source data, generated output or earlier frozen file changed by reviewer.

resolvedFindings.problem: The initial implementation iterated only the hashes supplied in parent-acceptance. Empty/incomplete worker-freeze and peer-receipt maps could disable intended proof gates. A temporary complete one-added-source fixture passed with both maps empty.
resolvedFindings.fixReviewed: Requires exactly all four worker-area freezes, nonempty pinned receipts, a pinned baseline-row-fingerprint hash, every accepted source manifest/payload/evidence/provenance path in its corresponding freeze, and an exact mapping from new accepted source IDs to nonempty distinct pinned reviews/independent-* files.
resolvedFindings.verification: Four added regression tests pass. In-memory calls to corrected main reject empty worker freezes and empty peer receipts before any output writes.

reasoning: Literal name/title, integer cents, null-versus-zero expenses, physical page and repeated-row multiplicity enter the multiset fingerprints. Group keys retain employer, actual period and source identity. All baseline groups must match exactly.
All earlier source metadata objects are checked before additions. New public source period/type/dates/warning/notes/validation/hashes/scope/URL and rows must match reviewed source inputs.
Global arithmetic requires exactly the accepted new official additions and preserves compiled rows. Unknown extra published rows cannot be hidden by arbitrary total changes.

Prior recovery frozen mode validates the historical35-source set, exact source manifests and proof receipts, new/published metadata and normalized row multisets, and continued absence of four reviewed compiled replacement groups. It ignores unrelated later global counts, so historical snapshots stay unchanged as separate collections grow.
The shared baseline loader preserves existing plainJSON behavior and supports historical gzip baselines. Wrong baseline totals still fail.
limits: The full new release generator cannot yet be run with a final real parent-acceptance and all four completed worker freezes while health processing continues. Root must run it after the final acceptance ledger is frozen.
This code review does not replace complete source/period/image peer review of any new NIC, school or health cohort, or final full rebuild/reconciliation and deployment checks.
Review hashes identify the exact versions inspected; later changes need a review addendum.
Ordinary CI assertions rely on normal Python execution without optimization, consistent with the workflow commands.
